fields.light:
Benary球根秋海棠Nonstop F1专用：发芽室10–100 ft. candles（原文附100–1,000 lx），14–16小时长日帮助萌发及苗质；这是育苗阶段，不是成株家庭照度。
4–6真叶、根到穴盘边缘时：14–16小时长日防结块茎并诱花，DLI 8–10 mol/m²/day（原文另列25,000–30,000 lx，非可脱离光周期的等价）；光强3,500–4,000 ft. candles时需遮阴防叶缘灼伤。花芽启动原文要求日长>13.5小时，或22:00–03:00的5小时夜间补光。

references.text: 1 mS/cm = 1 dS/m = 1,000 µS/cm；EC不能不问配方就换算成N ppm。Purdue只允许对新配制肥液，利用同配方100 ppm N的标签EC并扣除原水EC来计算；根区旧液不能用这个逻辑反算氮浓度。
references.quote:
Electrical conductivity is measured in Siemens (S) 
but ‘mho’s (opposite of ‘ohm’, the unit for resistance) 
are also occasionally used. Note that S = mho and 
one mS/cm = 1 dS/m = 1,000 µS/cm, where ‘m’ 
stands for ‘milli’, ‘d’ stands for ‘deci’ and ‘µ’ stands 
for ‘micro’.
Figure 1. This illustration describes the concept of electrical conductivity 
in solutions. The solution on the left is pure water and does not contain 
fertilizer ions. The one on the right contains dissolved fertilizer salts. If you 
apply an electric current to the solution, the electrical charges carry that 
current in the solution. The more electrical charge the greater the electrical 
conductivity. The conductivity of the solution on the left is influenced by 
hydrogen and hydroxyl ions. The dissolved fertilizer salts in the solution on 
the right carry additional electrical charge. More electricity is conducted 
through the fertilizer solution, because there are more charged particles 
in it than in pure water.
Why Is EC Useful? 
Electrical conductivity measurements are very 
useful in greenhouse production, because:
•	 You can measure the EC of a solution easily 
	
and quickly using affordable sensors
•	 The EC is proportional to the total amount 
	
of fertilizer salts present in a solution
It is important to note that EC indicates the total 
amount of fertilizer ions (nitrogen, phosphorus, 
and so on). But EC measurements are useful, 
because you can easily convert an EC reading to 
provide you with an accurate amount of nitrogen 
(N) in the solution (in parts per million, or ppm). 
However, this is done only for freshly prepared 
fertilizer solution.

references.quote: Rhizomatous begonias grow nicely when given adequate light without strong direct sun. Under a shade structure or a tree is good. A shaded greenhouse or a window free of direct sun also will suffice. You’ll know when light is insufficient because the leaf stems will elongate and the plant will grow lanky. Some varieties perform well outdoors with morning or afternoon sun in mild areas, but too much light will bleach leaves.

references.text: 用浅盆及粗、快速排水介质，根填满盆后只增一个盆号；春至秋介质表面触干再浇，冬季部分品种休眠时少浇。未提供泥炭/珍珠岩固定配比。
references.quote: To grow rhizomatous begonias well, use a shallow pot, preferably clay (but if your water is high in salts, plastic pots may be better), and a standard coarse, fast-draining planting mix. Don’t overwater or overpot — move a plant up to a pot only one size larger at a time and only when the roots have filled the present pot. A shallow, wide bonsai pot works nicely. During spring through fall, the time of active growth, water only when the surface of the soil feels dry to the touch. In winter, when some varieties become dormant (growth stops or slows), water only sparingly until growth resumes.
